message: aws:RequestTag/ManagedBy condition applied to statement covering both newly created resources (network-interface/*, security-group/*) and pre-existing referenced resources (subnet/*, vpc/*). IAM evaluates the condition per resource ARN — pre-existing resources do not carry request tags, so authorization will be denied at runtime for CreateSecurityGroup (vpc) and CreateNetworkInterface (subnet/security-group). Split into separate statements for created resources (with RequestTag condition) and referenced resources (without).
